title: Prescriptions: Early Fill Allowances by Handling Class
content:
Kestrel Prescriptions set, class by class, which reasons may bring a refill forward before its refill-eligible date and how often.

## Travel (vacation override) allowance

| Handling class | Vacation override allowed | Most vacation overrides per prescription in any rolling 365 days | Largest days supply of one vacation override refill |
|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Controlled Acute Prescription | No | 0 | 0 |
| Non-Controlled Maintenance Prescription | Yes | 2 | 90 |
| Schedule V Controlled Prescription | Yes | 1 | 30 |
| Schedule III-IV Controlled Prescription | No | 0 | 0 |
| Schedule II Controlled Prescription | No | 0 | 0 |
| Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription | Yes | 1 | 30 |

## Lost or stolen medication, and dose changes

| Handling class | Lost-or-stolen replacement allowed | Most lost-or-stolen replacements per prescription in any rolling 365 days | Police report number required | Early fill for a prescriber's dose change allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Controlled Acute Prescription | Yes | 1 | No | Yes |
| Non-Controlled Maintenance Prescription | Yes | 1 | No | Yes |
| Schedule V Controlled Prescription | Yes | 1 | Yes | No |
| Schedule III-IV Controlled Prescription | No | 0 | No | No |
| Schedule II Controlled Prescription | No | 0 | No | No |
| Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription | No | 0 | No | Yes |

## Questions the schedule answers

**Which classes allow a travel refill at all?** Non-Controlled Maintenance Prescription, Schedule V Controlled Prescription and Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription. The other three classes show No and a limit of 0.

**How large may one travel refill be on a Schedule V Controlled Prescription?** No more than 30 days supply, and no more than 1 such refill per prescription in any rolling 365 days.

**Which class asks for a police report number when medication is lost or stolen?** Under the class column, Schedule V Controlled Prescription is the only class marked Yes.

**Can a Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription be refilled early because medication was lost?** No; its lost-or-stolen replacement allowance is No with a limit of 0.
